## Try the extension

Preview build, not yet in the browser stores. Everything runs on your device.

**Chrome, Edge, Brave**
1. Download `fita-chrome-<version>.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` (Edge: `edge://extensions`) and turn on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and choose the unzipped folder.
4. Pin the icon, open any article, and click it or press **Alt+B**.

**Firefox** (until the signed version is on addons.mozilla.org)
1. Download `fita-firefox-<version>.zip`.
2. Open `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox`, click **Load Temporary Add-on…** and choose the zip.
3. It stays until you close Firefox.

Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/urimarti2610/fita/issues/new/choose).
